summary: Bilateral basilar opacification present on the prior study has largely cleared on the current image.

findings.rationale: Prior shows near-complete opacification of the right lower zone obscuring the hemidiaphragm/costophrenic angle and a hazy left lower zone; current shows well-aerated lungs with visible vascular markings and sharper costophrenic angles bilaterally. Numerous overlapping catheters/leads and differing patient positioning limit precise localization.
